about: Tape measurements of stretch waistbands for the step-3 control (docs/research/shortcut-to-step3.md §4; docs/REFINEMENT.md R3). Fill in relaxedCm (band lying flat, unstretched, measured edge to edge and doubled), stretchedCm (band pulled to its comfortable limit, doubled), hemSweepCm (hem lying flat, doubled) and the size measured. Then run: pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike exec tsx viewer/scripts/sizes-drape.ts out/eval/<handle> --modes base,band:measured --band-file data/bohohippychic/waistbands.json. Until a value is filled in, every band number in the step-3 results is an ASSUMPTION (the assumedSweep below).

assumedSweep.note: ASSUMED, not measured: relaxed / stretched girth of the base size (AU 12), cm; other sizes step by the chart's hip step (5 cm) and keep the stretch ratio.
